content.title: Padres Games: How to Watch | San Diego Padres
content.text: Here are all the ways to catch Padres baseball this season!Watch:Catch games locally on television on DirecTV (channel 694-3), AT&T U-Verse (channel 781 or 1781), Cox (channel 83), and Spectrum (channel 305 or 443). Additionally, use the channel finder below to find out how to watch Padres baseball in your area.Returning in 2026, fans in the Padres’ TV market can watch 10 regular season Saturday games for free on CBS 8 (KFMB). The first simulcast will air on Saturday, April 11, when the Colorado Rockies visit Petco Park.Stream:Fans in San Diego, Tijuana or the Padres home television territory can stream all home and away games on Padres.TV (subject to national exclusivities) for just $19.99/month! Plus, start with a 7-day free trial below.Additionally, Padres games are available to stream on FUBO.Listen:Enjoy live coverage of all 162 regular season games in both English and Spanish in 2026. Listen in English on 97.3 The Fan or stream through the Audacy app, and listen in Spanish on XEMO-AM La Poderosa 860.Channel Finder - Where to Watch Padres GamesPADRES.TV FAQsHow Do I Stream PADRES.TV in the San Diego area?PADRES.TV subscribers located in San Diego, Tijuana, and the club’s home television territory are able to access San Diego Padres games. This offer is a separate service than the MLB.TV out of market package.PADRES.TV will be offered for $19.99 per month or $99.99 for the full regular season.How do I watch Padres baseball if I live outside of the San Diego area?Existing out-of-market yearly and monthly subscribers, including subscribers who received a subscription via T-Mobile, can continue to watch San Diego Padres games on MLB.TV. Non-subscribers will need to purchase an MLB.TV Yearly or Monthly subscription in order to watch. Full details on all MLB.TV product offerings can be found here.How do I know if I live in the Padres home territory?A map of the Padres home television territory is below. You can also use the Channel Finder to enter your zip code.Can MLB.TV All Teams Subscribers Watch Padres games on MLB.TV in the San Diego area?Only users that have specifically purchased the 2026 PADRES.TV Package or the PADRES.TV/ MLB.TV Bundle subscription will be able to stream Padres games in the San Diego area or the club’s home television territory. MLB.TV All Teams out-of-market subscribers will not have access and will need to purchase PADRES.TV in order to stream Padres games in the San Diego area.If I’m a Padres Season Ticket Member with MLB.TV, what does this mean for me?Padres Season Ticket Members receive a free MLB.TV All Teams Subscription as a membership benefit. However, only users that specifically purchase a PADRES.TV subscription will be able to stream Padres regular season games in San Diego, Tijuana, and the club’s home television territory. Members need to add-on this package. Members should not enable their free MLB.TV All Teams subscription to watch Padres home games. Instead, they should subscribe to the new PADRES.TV package.How do I contact PADRES.TV support?If you are having issues accessing a game or have questions about your account you can visit our full online Support Page. You can also call our toll-free support (866.244.2291), email by clicking here, on Social @MLBFanSupport or via Virtual Assistant.Where can I find additional information about Padres.TV?Please visit our Padres.TV FAQs page for additional information including the free trial policy, supported devices, and more.
